provenance.method: Bounded review of current Apple UK cognitive-accessibility documentation for iPhone; OS-version dependence preserved.

name: Apple iPhone cognitive accessibility features
description: Apple support overview of iPhone features relevant to cognitive accessibility, focus, reading, dictation and reducing sensory stimulus such as onscreen motion.
intended_use: Inspecting built-in iPhone settings before adding another app or service.
audience_or_context: iPhone users; exact features depend on current iOS version, device and region.
limitations: First-party documentation describes available features, not independent evidence of personal benefit.
Settings and feature names can change between iOS releases.
cost_or_access_notes: Features described are built into supported Apple devices; device costs are separate.
conflicts_of_interest: Apple develops and sells the devices and operating system; ND Oracle records feature documentation without endorsement.
